name: Huge wordmark with a glossy accent sphere
looks: A single small line of type sits quietly at left, then a massive cropped display word fills the frame, its trailing full stop replaced by a glossy, lit 3D sphere in the accent colour, a faint wall of scrolling industry-critique text drifting behind it out of focus.
build: The small opening line fades in alone first; hard cut to the giant word, cropped tight by the frame edges, type static while the sphere behind its final letter has a real specular highlight and a soft ground shadow to read as 3D among flat type. Background ticker text scrolls continuously at low opacity, never sharp.
sound: A quiet ambient hum under the opening line, a deep low thud on the cut to the giant word.
prompt: Open on one quiet line of type, then hard-cut to a massive, frame-cropped display word with its final punctuation replaced by a glossy lit 3D sphere in the accent colour, a wall of related commentary text scrolling softly out of focus behind it.
